items: Launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs on June 25, 2015, the mission aims to
develop 100 smart cities across India by March 31, 2025.
o Integrated Command and Control Centers (ICCCs)
o Technological Integration for Urban Mobility, Smart Governance, and Sustainability
o Focus on Affordable Housing, Quality Education, and Citizen Engagement
o Environmental Sustainability and Improved Quality of Life
o Rajasthan: Jaipur, Udaipur, Kota, and Ajmer
The mission seeks to create sustainable, efficient, and citizen-centric urban spaces across India.
